title: sourceglint common definitions
description: Shared definitions reused across sourceglint contracts. Single source of truth for ID formats, confidence scale, timestamp format, market/locale/language codes, and the GTM dimension enum. Change Control: any edit here is a contract change and requires an ADR.

evidence_id.description: Evidence ID. Prefix ev_. Deterministic-derived (source +  stable hash) by the ledger generator, never a random UUID.  Must be stable to support dedup, citation integrity and  regression tests.

signal_id.description: Signal Cluster ID. Prefix sig_. Deterministic-derived.

confidence.description: Canonical confidence / score scale across ALL contracts:  0.0-1.0. UI/renderer maps to High/Medium/Low; the contract  keeps a single SoT (PRD §7).

iso_timestamp.description: RFC3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. 2026-08-30T12:00:00Z.  Offset forms (+09:00) are accepted by format; storage is  UTC-preferred.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL. No other schemes. Scheme is never  trusted from model output — injected by renderer from ledger.

market_code.description: Market: 'global' or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (jp, us, de...).

locale_code.description: Locale (BCP-47 style), e.g. ja-JP, de-DE, en. Language part  lowercase, region uppercase.

language_code.description: Bare language code (ISO 639), e.g. en, ja, de. Region goes  in locale, not here.

gtm_dimension.description: Finite GTM dimension enum (v0.2 §19 D-implied + PRD §12).  Extending requires an explicit WHY + ADR; ad-hoc additions  for single test cases are forbidden.
